statement.zh: 吉萨孟卡拉金字塔庙、谷庙与王后金字塔礼拜堂发掘结果见 Reisner《孟卡拉》（1931，哈佛—美艺馆联合队正式报告）。
statement.en: At Giza, excavation results for the Menkaure pyramid temple, valley temple, and queens’ pyramid chapels are documented in Reisner Mycerinus (1931, Harvard–MFA joint expedition final report).
